purpose: T045's registered shuffled-prompt junk control: e073 found negative-utility cache entries concentrate in GENERATED entries while corpus-prompt entries almost never hurt, but age and source correlate by design (prompt = oldest 64). Discriminator: replace the 64 prompt tokens with a random permutation of themselves (corpus statistics destroyed; age+count+recency and the generated tail kept bit-identical), re-run the same 511-position V-zero sweep. FROZEN: shuffled-prompt junk <= 0.05 => H-SOURCE (self-generation is the poison); >= 0.15 => H-AGE-STATISTICS (any info-poor old band drifts negative). Secondary: junk by generation order (early vs late halves); H-source predicts late junk more.

seeds.shuffle_note: one generator seed 74; randperm(64) per sequence in row order

protocol.frames: battery A seeds 202/7 verbatim (e069/e070/e072); native eval-512 frame; shuffled frame = same sequences with prompt tokens 0..63 permuted in place, wpe unchanged

prompt.note: position 0 (sequence start, age 511) excluded as in e073 (n=63); measured separately as pos0_dce

generated.ages: 1..447, restricted to >= the sweep's own a* (baseline 6 -> positions 64..505, n=442)

bands.statistic: mean over sequences of the per-seq junk fraction (e073 generated-band convention); max/pooled/counts recorded too (e073's stored prompt number 4/63 is the max reading)

G4_junk_instrument_vs_e073.note: e073's stored prompt_junk 4/63 is the MAX-over-seqs reading of this band (per-seq counts [0,4,1,0]); its gen_old_junk is the mean-over-seqs reading. Both reproduce here under those readings.

secondary_generation_order.registered_prediction: H-source: late-generation entries (more accumulated drift) junk MORE

registered_decision.verdict: H-SOURCE (strict sleeper) fires: shuffled-prompt-band junk = 0.0238 <= 0.05 (max-over-seqs 0.0476) — destroying corpus statistics created NO new junk in the prompt band; the poison stays in the GENERATED band (shuffled-run generated junk 0.1024 vs baseline 0.0995). Age+count+recency alone do not make an old band go negative.
